condition_other: surgical stress-induced post-operative hyperglycaemia (small bowel resection)
readout_other: hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic clamp glucose infusion rate; fasting blood glucose
direction_notes: SMP-FUS increased insulin sensitivity more than PH-FUS, and increased insulin sensitivity versus sham on the day of surgery in some animals, but SMP-FUS-treated animals had a larger rise in next-day fasting glucose.

device.model: LOGIQ E10 with customized dual-use probe

timing.protocol_description: Image-guided FUS to the SMP for 30 min before bowel resection, at 55% of maximum output in the healthy-animal experiment; hardware only permitted adjusting output power and duration. Sham: probe placed in comparable location without FUS.

device.model: LOGIQ E10 with customized dual-use probe

timing.protocol_description: Image-guided FUS to the porta hepatis for 30 min in 3 healthy anaesthetised pigs, at 55% of maximum output.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Subsequently, we assessed the direct efect of FUS of the SMP on insulin sensitivity and its delayed efect on fasting blood glucose in 7 animals that underwent surgical stress: 4 receiving FUS of the SMP and 3 receiving sham treatment.
